verdict.rationale: Fellow's docs say every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript (fellow-docs-21), and recordings carry diarized, timestamped transcripts (fellow-docs-36, fellow-docs-60). Cross-meeting Q&A exists via 'Ask Fellow' and the MCP server ('What did we decide in last month's standup?'), but these are AI question-answering rather than documented search. Missing for 10: explicit unified search spanning summaries and notes as well as transcripts, a documented jump-to-timestamp or playback-at-moment feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
